text.en: Good morning, {player_name}. The road to Chang'an West Market is open.
text.zh: 早上好，{player_name}。通往长安西市的路打开了。

text.en: The mist is thin in the morning. Try saying: Good morning.
text.zh: 清晨的雾比较薄。试着说：Good morning。

text.en: Good! Your voice made the morning mist move.
text.zh: 很好！你的声音让晨雾动起来了。

text.en: You can start with two words: Good morning.
text.zh: 可以先说两个词：Good morning。

text.en: Stop, young traveler. The West Market is covered by the Chaos Mist.
text.zh: 且慢，年轻的旅人。长安西市正被混沌迷雾笼罩。

text.en: A new voice must give a name before entering.
text.zh: 新来的声音，入市前必须留下名字。

text.en: Tell him: My name is {player_name}.
text.zh: 告诉他：My name is {player_name}。

text.en: Your name is clear. You are new here, but the gate knows you now.
text.zh: 你的名字清楚了。你是新来的，但雾门现在认得你了。

text.en: New does not mean weak. It means your story just began.
text.zh: 新来的不代表弱小，只代表你的故事刚刚开始。

text.en: Say your name in a full sentence: My name is {player_name}.
text.zh: 用完整句子说出名字：My name is {player_name}。

text.en: Two other learners are lost in the mist. Wait here.
text.zh: 还有两位修习者迷在雾里。你先在这里等候。

text.en: Please sit here.
text.zh: 请坐在这里。

text.en: Good. You can listen before you speak. That is important.
text.zh: 很好。先听清，再开口，这很重要。

text.en: Almost. Look at the bright stone. Sit here.
text.zh: 差一点。看发光的石凳。Sit here。

text.en: Hello? Can anyone hear me?
text.zh: Hello？有人能听见我吗？

text.en: My name is A-Ling. I came for the morning lesson.
text.zh: My name is A-Ling。我是来参加晨课的。

text.en: Tell the steward: Her name is A-Ling.
text.zh: 告诉执事：Her name is A-Ling。

text.en: Thank you. My name feels steady again.
text.zh: 谢谢你。我的名字又稳定了。

text.en: Correct. Her name is A-Ling. She is your classmate today.
text.zh: 正确。她的名字是阿菱。今天她是你的同修伙伴。

text.en: A-Ling is a girl. Try: Her name is A-Ling.
text.zh: 阿菱是女孩。试试：Her name is A-Ling。

text.en: Hey! Is this the morning lesson? I almost walked into the spice stall.
text.zh: 喂！这里是晨课吗？我刚才差点走进香料摊了。

text.en: My name is Haoran. I know many roads in the West Market.
text.zh: My name is Haoran。我熟悉长安西市的许多路。

text.en: Now tell the steward his name.
text.zh: 现在告诉执事他的名字。

text.en: Yes! His name is Haoran. That is me.
text.zh: 对！His name is Haoran。说的就是我。

text.en: Good. He is your classmate today.
text.zh: 很好。今天他也是你的同修伙伴。

text.en: Haoran is a boy. Try: His name is Haoran.
text.zh: 昊然是男孩。试试：His name is Haoran。

text.en: Three new voices, one morning lesson.
text.zh: 三个新声音，同上一堂晨课。

text.en: From now on, you are classmates for this trial.
text.zh: 从现在起，你们就是这场试炼中的同修伙伴。

text.en: Say: I meet new classmates.
text.zh: 试着说：I meet new classmates。

text.en: Good. You met new classmates, and you did not hide your voice.
text.zh: 很好。你认识了新的同修，也没有藏起自己的声音。

text.en: Try the key words first: new classmates.
text.zh: 先试试关键词：new classmates。

text.en: A voice that dares to greet can also learn to listen.
text.zh: 敢于问候的声音，也能学会倾听。

text.en: Let the child pass deeper into the West Market.
text.zh: 让这孩子再往西市深处走一段吧。

text.en: The first step is done. The East Bell may be waiting ahead.
text.zh: 第一步完成了。东皇钟也许就在前方等待。

text.en: Good afternoon, {player_name}. We are back at Mirage Inn.
text.zh: 下午好，{player_name}。我们回到蜃影客栈了。

text.en: Morning was for meeting. Afternoon is for remembering.
text.zh: 早上用来认识，下午用来记住。

text.en: Try saying: Good afternoon.
text.zh: 试着说：Good afternoon。

text.en: Good afternoon. Now let us remember who you met.
text.zh: 下午好。现在我们来记住你今天认识了谁。

text.en: This is A-Ling. Tell me her name.
text.zh: 这是阿菱。告诉我她的名字。

text.en: Her name is A-Ling.
text.zh: Her name is A-Ling。

text.en: This is Haoran. Tell me his name.
text.zh: 这是昊然。告诉我他的名字。

text.en: His name is Haoran.
text.zh: His name is Haoran。

text.en: Today you learned to meet, listen, and remember names.
text.zh: 今天你学会了见面、倾听，也记住了名字。

text.en: That is the first kind of courage.
text.zh: 这就是第一种勇气。

text.en: Afternoon means the later part of the day. Say: Good afternoon.
text.zh: Afternoon 是一天后半段。说：Good afternoon。
